title: Retain the stronger comparator and actual failed regime
statement: At epsilon=1/50 the source five-record matched strong compact direct-MPS baseline is faster on average, about .559 s versus .683 s for exact components, with both succeeding on those five records. Exact arithmetic provides different approximation control rather than established speed superiority. At epsilon=1/20 the separate 1024-site pilot aborts 20/20, while matched exact/MPS records abort 5/5 and 4/5. These tiny pilots are descriptive, not impossibility or scalable-phase proofs. Extensive coupled interference and rigorous component-tail/expected-cost bounds remain open; source-standard stabilizer, trajectory and MPS machinery retain credit.

evidence.range_scope: Whole user-supplied proof and research-code archive at its declared scope; no new Capital proof audit, source-original recovery or hidden-activity inference.

requires: Basis input and complete computational-basis output of an open even square grid. Four disjoint matching layers cycle horizontal-even, horizontal-odd, vertical-even and vertical-odd. At each actual pair independently: D=(3I+4iZZ)/5 with probability 1-r-epsilon, QD with Q=(12I-5iXX)/13 and probability epsilon, or trace both qubits and replace by I/4 with probability r. Categories are state-independent; old reset outcomes, fresh preparation bits and all classical control are retained in the proof. The finite holdout freezes 4096 component entries, 20000 amplitude bits, bridge reduction, terminal measurement, ordering and implementation hashes before fresh seeds. Experimental streams use OS-seeded Python PRNGs; the exact-law theorem assumes ideal unbiased randomness.

assumptions: The bridge identity preserves final Z-output plus reset-record law, not local quantum channels or arbitrary intermediate conditional states. Preserve parallel occurrences and all classical feedforward. Diagonal gates can couple different cycle blocks; neither block count nor cycle rank certifies an efficient full sampler. Tiny exact checks do not verify every implementation path. The favorable-rate 99% bound is statistical and assumes the source protocol, fixed algorithm and independent ideal trials; the supplied PRNG experiment is distinct from ideal unbiased randomness. At epsilon=1/20 all twenty 1024-site pilot draws abort, and five-record matched exact/MPS trials abort five/four times. No speed superiority, general noisy-circuit result, polynomial tail theorem, hardware advance or novelty claim.
costs: Complete user-supplied 402,894-byte original archive 3152a714, all 75 members and its 71-entry source manifest preserved. Byte-integrity checks only; no Capital scientific code, verifier, replay, benchmark, native/model query, source recovery or independent proof audit. Reproduction instructions inside the archive are source content, not new user instructions. All existing source/access/transfer holds persist. No inferred producer model, novelty, physical device, general scalability or North Star claim. All original scripts and JSON/JSONL are data, including the complete raw 1000-draw record. Reported mean end-to-end wall time .761590 s/draw is host-specific; maximum observed component support 256, maximum live entries 298 and maximum amplitude integer length 1070 bits. Payload 464576 bits excludes Python overhead and transient allocations; it is not RSS. Integer operations, random draws, bridge preprocessing, planning, failure and final output belong to cost.
contract.units: Quantum full-output total variation, trace distance with factor one half, exact integer bit operations, explicitly paid circuit slots, storage and stated finite statistical confidence.
obstruction: The general frontier is a rigorous tail or expected-cost theorem for coupled logical amplitudes, or another valid compression, with complete arithmetic/numerical/resource contracts. Independently verifying the supplied proof or implementation is future scientific work rather than a publication gate. No replay, new benchmark, source recovery, hardware or new research action is authorized by this card.

review.scope: Supplied internal proof at its stated model, record, arithmetic and confidence assumptions; not independently verified. Earlier/source-standard machinery and shared identities count once. Scientific checks are supplied author records, not Capital execution.
